channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Louis Williams | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Louis Williams from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Ice Cube on Louis Williams, Isaiah Thomas
item.description:
Ice Cube:

“My man Boogie going overseas. Boogie, come play in the Big3 on CBS, man! Sometimes I feel a little conflicted about asking guys to come to the league when I know they still deserve to be in the NBA. And he's a guy that deserves to be in the NBA, Isaiah Thomas is a guy that deserves to be in the NBA right, Lou Williams deserves to be in the NBA. So I'll be a little conflicted about asking them, but if they don't want you, we do got you! You know, get down for the fans in the league where you can shine and be treated like the superstar that you are.”

Ice Cube on Louis Williams, Isaiah Thomas, Apr 12, 2023. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Ivica Zubac on Louis Williams
item.description:
Mirjam Swanson:Ivica Zubac on losing Lou Williams in last week's trade:

“It was tough. I've been playing with Lou for most of my career and I learned a lot of stuff from Lou,and I love playing with him and I love being his teammate. It was definitely tough because we were in this together.”

Ivica Zubac on Louis Williams, Mar 29, 2021. Source: Twitter @MirjamSwanson.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Louis Williams
item.description:
Ohm Youngmisuk:Doc Rivers on Lou Williams, who is averaging 10.5 points, shooting 3-23 from 3-point range:

“I thought for the first time since really the playoffs have started that he played with Lou Williams pace (in Game 6). That is all I have been telling him... Just get back to your pace.”

Doc Rivers on Louis Williams, Sep 14, 2020. Source: Twitter @NotoriousOHM.

item.title: Michael Malone on Louis Williams
item.description:
Michael Malone:

“I’m sure sometime in the next few years, they’ll name the 6th Man of the Year after Lou Williams.”

Michael Malone on Louis Williams, Sep 5, 2020. Source: Twitter @msinger.

item.title: Malcolm Brogdon on Louis Williams
item.description:
“Louis Williams and guys like that get that name. T.J. knows how to score the ball. Now he's expanded his game. He's worked extremely hard on his 3 ball, extremely hard on his body, he's in great shape. I think he's going to have a huge season.”

Malcolm Brogdon on Louis Williams, Oct 9, 2019. Source: Indianapolis Star.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Louis Williams
item.description:
Kevin Durant on @Louis Williams:

“You can't just say, 'I'm going to stop Lou Williams tonight.' You just hope you're locked in enough to stop him. ... He got loose.”

Kevin Durant on Louis Williams, Apr 25, 2019. Source: Twitter @AndrewGreif.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Louis Williams
item.description:
Celtics head coach Brad Stevens said:

“Most guys like Lou Williams don’t come off the bench. And that makes me appreciate him even more.”

Brad Stevens on Louis Williams, Mar 12, 2019. Source: The Undefeated.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Louis Williams
item.description:
James Edwards III:Dwane Casey:

“Devastating. We're like two different teams. Thought we played some of our best basketball. ...And then I don't think we sent Lou Williams the right way in the second half.”

Dwane Casey on Louis Williams, Feb 2, 2019. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Louis Williams
item.description:
Ben Golliver:Doc Rivers on All-Star draft & Lou Williams 2018 snub:

“Last year they were cowards & this year they’re doing it live so we know who gets picked. Next step is coaches reveal their vote. I have too many coaches saying they voted for my guy; if that was true then he’d be on team.”

Doc Rivers on Louis Williams, Jan 27, 2019. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Louis Williams
item.description:
Calvin Watkins:Morey on the Warriors on @NBATV 10 Before Tip:

“I don't think they're guardable. I don't think their a team that u can defend. But we felt like Lou Williams gives us the best chance to win against all opponents...”

Daryl Morey on Louis Williams, Mar 3, 2017. Source: Twitter @calvinwatkins.
